response.sql: WITH equipment_averages AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg FROM equipment_averages), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, o.overall_avg FROM equipment_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND e.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg), compared AS (SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, overall_avg, AVG(avg_humidity) OVER () AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, avg_humidity - overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_avg, ABS(avg_humidity - kept_avg) AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM compared WHERE kept_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES

assumptions.assumption: “How far” means the absolute distance from the kept-equipment mean.

alternatives.interpretation: If the last difference means signed deviation from the kept-equipment mean, retain negative values for equipment below that mean.
alternatives.sql: WITH equipment_averages AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg FROM equipment_averages), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, o.overall_avg FROM equipment_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND e.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg), compared AS (SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, overall_avg, AVG(avg_humidity) OVER () AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, avg_humidity - overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_avg, avg_humidity - kept_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM compared WHERE kept_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES
